general.registro_b2_acto_denegado: You do not have permission to register this action.

general.organizacion_localNotice: This review checks the selected file; it does not change the organisation.
general.organizacion_localHelp: Select a sample file to check its format, dates and record count. If errors appear, correct the file and select it again. Use the appropriate procedure to change the organisation.
general.organizacion_localReady: Select a file to check its format.
general.organizacion_localBadPackage: The file could not be reviewed. Check that it contains the list of units and select it again.
general.organizacion_localTooLarge: The file exceeds 8 MiB. Select a smaller file.
general.organizacion_localManifestInterval: Check the file’s overall dates: the end must be after the start.
general.organizacion_localRowInterval: Check row {fila}: the end date must be later than the start date.
general.organizacion_localManifestDate: Check the file’s overall dates. Use yyyy-mm-dd and a valid date.
general.organizacion_localRowDate: Check the dates in row {fila}. Use the yyyy-mm-dd format and a date that exists.
general.organizacion_importPublishBlocked: Publishing is not yet available from this screen. Check with the responsible team before treating these data as final.
general.organizacion_importHelp: Select the data file and review the preparation. Then select the decisions and check the reconciliation. If you cannot confirm a change, select “Retry exactly” before starting another. Publishing requires review and approval through the appropriate procedure.
general.organizacion_importReady: Select a file to prepare the changes.
general.organizacion_importPackageReady: File ready for review. The changes have not yet been recorded.
general.organizacion_importBadPackage: The file could not be prepared. Check its data and select it again.
general.organizacion_importBadDecisions: The decisions could not be reviewed. Check the file and select it again.
general.organizacion_importTooLarge: The file exceeds the 8 MiB limit. Select a smaller file.
general.organizacion_importRejected: The change could not be recorded. Check the data and your access, then try again.
general.organizacion_importDenied: You do not have permission for this operation.
general.organizacion_importConflict: The data changed during review. Retrieve the latest revision and check the changes before continuing.
general.organizacion_importUncertain: The change could not be confirmed. Select “Retry exactly” before starting another action.
general.organizacion_importFileReadError: The selected file could not be read.
general.organizacion_historyLoaded: Results loaded. Check the dates and whether the information is complete.
general.organizacion_historyDenied: You do not have permission for this search.
general.organizacion_historyError: The history could not be checked. Check the filters and try again.
general.organizacion_historyInvalid: Select valid dates for the search.
general.organizacion_historyEmpty: No results for these dates. Check whether the information is complete before concluding there are no records.
general.organizacion_historyPageScope: Results on this page and information coverage
general.organizacion_intro: View organisational units and prepare changes when needed.
general.organizacion_provenanceDetail: Provenance and scope of the data
general.organizacion_notice: You can prepare changes to units. Check responsibilities and post holders through the appropriate procedure before using them for staff management.
general.estructura_buscar: Search by name or parent unit
general.organizacion_note: Check the official code before using a unit in other procedures.
general.organizacion_error: The organisation could not be loaded.
general.organizacion_empty: There are no units matching the filters.
general.organizacion_editorTitle: Prepare a new entry or edit
general.organizacion_editorHelper: This form saves name, type and attachment. Review the summary before confirming; it does not enable ratification.
general.organizacion_conflict: The catalogue changed. The form is kept; reload before confirming.
general.organizacion_uncertain: The change could not be confirmed. Select “Retry the same change” before starting another.
general.organizacion_reloadError: The receipt is kept, but the catalogue could not be reloaded.
general.organizacion_rejected: Change rejected without saving. Review the data, the attachment and your permissions before confirming again.

general.catalogo_servicio_no_disponible: The professional catalogue search is temporarily unavailable. No previous data is shown.

general.catalogo_vacio: There are no professional categories for these filters.
general.catalogo_filtro_invalido: Check your search or the selected area.

general.estructura_aviso: This structure is being prepared. Check the current organisation before assigning responsibilities or processing changes.

general.ficha_fuente_pendiente: Select a section of your record. If the expected information is missing, select Retry.
general.ficha_sin_datos: Some information is unavailable. Missing information does not mean an amount or period is zero; contact HR if you need confirmation.
general.ficha_empleo_ayuda: Employment relationships, attachments, occupations and posts with their effective dates.
general.ficha_servicios_ayuda: Recognised periods, provenance and recognition actions. Three-year increments and entitlements are not calculated.
general.ficha_tiempo_ayuda: View your clock entries and working time issues in Cronos. For recognised service and seniority, open Services.
general.ficha_formacion_ayuda: View available courses, attendance and certificates. Enrolment does not mean the course was completed.
general.ficha_economia_ayuda: View your payslips and contributions by period when this section becomes available.
general.ficha_documentos_ayuda: View the document list and each item’s status. Ask the responsible team for an original.
general.ficha_descarga_motivo: No document is available to download. Contact HR if you expected to find one.

general.ficha_navegacion_pendiente: This section is not yet available.
general.ficha_sesion_caducada: Your session has expired. Sign in again to view your record.
